ingest.note: Consumes text chunks; no audio input.

egress.note: Output format is chosen via output_format = codec_sampleRate_bitrate. Options include mp3_22050_32, mp3_44100_128, pcm_16000, pcm_44100, and ulaw_8000_8 (μ-law 8 kHz, native for Twilio/telephony).

potholes.note: ElevenLabs can emit ulaw_8000_8 directly. For a Twilio/Exotel μ-law leg, request this format to SKIP the resample + μ-law encode stage entirely. Falls back to PCM/MP3 + your own encode if unavailable.
If you select an MP3 format, streaming MP3 needs a stateful decoder (not per-chunk) before resampling. Prefer pcm_16000 or ulaw_8000_8 to avoid decoding entirely.
First-byte latency dominates perceived responsiveness. Stream text as soon as the LLM emits tokens; do not wait for a full sentence before calling TTS. Use optimize_streaming_latency up to 4.
